name: Wyn City Drinks Knowledge — Updated 30-question bank

questions.prompt: What does “vintage” mean on a bottle of wine?
options: The year the wine was bottled
The year the grapes were harvested
The number of years the wine spent in oak barrels
The year the winery was established

questions.prompt: What is the difference between Bourbon and Scotch whisky?
options: Bourbon is made primarily from barley, while Scotch is made primarily from corn
Bourbon must be made in Scotland, while Scotch must be made in the United States
Bourbon must contain at least 51% corn and be made in the United States, while Scotch must be made and matured in Scotland under Scotch whisky regulations
Bourbon is always aged for longer than Scotch whisky

questions.prompt: What do Brut and Demi-Sec mean on sparkling wine labels?
options: They indicate the wine’s alcohol strength
Brut generally indicates a drier style, while Demi-Sec is noticeably sweeter
Brut means the wine is aged in oak, while Demi-Sec means it is aged in steel tanks
Brut is exclusively made in France, while Demi-Sec is exclusively made in Italy

questions.prompt: What is the difference between Blanco, Reposado and Añejo tequila?
options: They indicate different levels of sweetness
They indicate the type of agave used
They are categories primarily distinguished by ageing and maturation
They indicate whether the tequila is made in Mexico or Spain

questions.prompt: What is rum primarily made from?
options: Fermented grapes or grape juice
Sugar cane juice or molasses
Malted barley and corn
Blue Weber agave

questions.prompt: What does “Blanc de Blancs” mean?
options: White wine made exclusively from white grapes
White wine made exclusively from red grapes
A wine made only from Pinot Noir
A wine made from a blend of red and white grapes

questions.prompt: A customer wants a wine under ₦10,000. What is the best way to recommend a suitable bottle?
options: Recommend the cheapest wine without asking questions
Recommend the most popular wine regardless of the customer’s taste
Ask about preferred sweetness, colour, occasion and budget, then suggest a suitable available bottle
Recommend a wine above their budget because it is likely to be better

questions.prompt: What is the difference between Cognac and whisky?
options: Cognac is a grape-based spirit from the Cognac region of France, while whisky is a grain-based spirit
Cognac is made from sugar cane, while whisky is made from grapes
Cognac must be made in Scotland, while whisky must be made in France
Cognac is always sweeter and weaker than whisky

questions.prompt: A customer requests a drink that is out of stock. What should you do?
options: Substitute another product without informing the customer
Tell the customer to come back another day without checking alternatives
Ask about the customer’s preferences and recommend a suitable alternative, explaining differences in price or taste
Recommend the most expensive drink available

questions.prompt: A customer asks why one whisky costs more than another. What is the best explanation?
options: The more expensive whisky is always better quality
Price differences may reflect age, production methods, cask selection, rarity, brand positioning and demand
The more expensive whisky must always have a higher alcohol percentage
The cheaper whisky is likely to be counterfeit

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between single malt and blended Scotch whisky?
options: Single malt must come from one cask, while blended Scotch combines whiskies from one distillery
Single malt is made at one distillery from malted barley; blended Scotch combines single malt and grain Scotch whiskies
Single malt is always older than blended Scotch
Single malt is distilled once, while blended Scotch is distilled twice

questions.prompt: What does “oaked” generally mean when describing wine?
options: The wine has been fermented with oak leaves
The wine has been matured in or exposed to oak, which can influence flavour and texture
The wine has a naturally high sugar content
The wine has been blended exclusively with older wines

questions.prompt: What does VSOP indicate on a Cognac label?
options: The youngest eau-de-vie in the blend has a minimum age of four years under Cognac rules
The Cognac has been aged for at least ten years
The Cognac comes from a single vineyard
The Cognac has been distilled five times

questions.prompt: What gives peated whisky its characteristic smoky flavour?
options: The use of charred oak casks alone
The addition of smoked flavouring after distillation
Exposure to peat smoke during the drying of malted barley
The use of grain spirit instead of malt spirit

questions.prompt: What is the key difference between triple distillation and triple cask maturation?
options: Triple distillation refers to three distillation stages; triple cask refers to maturation involving three types of cask
Triple distillation means three years of ageing; triple cask means three distillation stages
Both terms describe the number of years the whisky spends in oak
Triple cask means the whisky must be distilled in three countries

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes Chardonnay?
options: It is a red grape mainly associated with tannic wines
It is a white grape that can produce styles from crisp and unoaked to rich and oak-influenced
It is used exclusively for sweet dessert wines
It always produces highly aromatic, floral wines

questions.prompt: Which plant is essential to the production of tequila?
options: Blue Weber agave
Sugar cane
Juniper berries
Malted barley

questions.prompt: A bottle states 40% ABV. What does this mean?
options: Forty per cent of the bottle’s weight is pure alcohol
Forty per cent of the liquid’s volume is alcohol
The drink contains 40 grams of alcohol per 100 millilitres
The drink is 40 years old

questions.prompt: What is the best first step when a customer says they prefer a “smooth” whisky?
options: Assume they want the oldest bottle in stock
Ask what flavours they enjoy and what budget they have, then suggest suitable options
Recommend the highest-ABV whisky because it tastes smoother
Recommend any whisky with a dark colour

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable way to explain a drink’s flavour profile to a customer?
options: Promise the customer they will taste exactly the same notes as the staff member
Use clear, accurate descriptors and explain that individual perception can vary
Describe every whisky as smoky and every wine as fruity
Use only technical terms and avoid asking what the customer likes

questions.prompt: Which grape is most closely associated with many classic Sauvignon Blanc wines?
options: Sauvignon Blanc
Merlot
Syrah
Tempranillo

questions.prompt: What does “dry” generally mean when describing wine?
options: The wine has no liquid left in it
The wine has little residual sugar and is not noticeably sweet
The wine has been aged in a dry climate
The wine has a high alcohol percentage

questions.prompt: What does “cask strength” generally mean on a whisky bottle?
options: The whisky is bottled at or close to its strength from the cask, rather than reduced to a standard strength
The whisky has been matured for the full legal ageing period in one cask
The whisky has exactly 40% ABV
The whisky has been matured in a cask made from one type of grain

questions.prompt: What is the main flavouring botanical traditionally required for gin?
options: Juniper
Vanilla
Cinnamon
Ginger

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the difference between gin and vodka?
options: Gin must have a predominant juniper flavour; vodka is not defined by that requirement
Gin must be aged in oak, while vodka must be aged in steel
Vodka is made only from potatoes, while gin is made only from grapes
Gin always has a higher ABV than vodka

questions.prompt: What does XO generally indicate on a Cognac label under current rules?
options: The youngest eau-de-vie in the blend has a minimum age of ten years
The Cognac has been bottled for at least ten years
The oldest eau-de-vie is exactly ten years old
The grapes were harvested ten years ago

questions.prompt: What is the difference between sparkling wine and Champagne?
options: All sparkling wine is Champagne, regardless of where it is made
Champagne is a protected sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France, while sparkling wine is the broader category
Champagne is always sweeter than every other sparkling wine
Sparkling wine must be made in Italy, while Champagne is made in France

questions.prompt: What is the best way to help a customer choose a gift bottle?
options: Recommend the most expensive bottle regardless of context
Ask about the recipient’s preferences, the occasion and the budget before recommending options
Recommend the same bottle to every customer
Choose a bottle based only on the label colour

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a liqueur and a typical unsweetened spirit such as vodka?
options: Liqueurs are generally sweetened and flavoured; vodka is generally an unsweetened spirit
Liqueurs must be made from grapes, while vodka must be made from corn
Vodka is always aged in oak, while liqueurs are never aged
They are exactly the same category of drink

questions.prompt: A customer asks how to store an opened bottle of wine. What is the best general advice?
options: Leave it uncorked at room temperature for a week
Reseal it, refrigerate it where appropriate, and consume it within a few days depending on the style
Store it beside a hot window to preserve the aroma
Transfer it to an open glass and leave it in direct sunlight
